code.note: 06_simulation run_pipeline.run in-process (seed 0, single mother, step 6 on main), observation written with io_utils.write_run_folder and read with estimation.sim_outputs.read_sim_output; estimate() with its defaults (thermal fitted, air_prior ground, KNMI 344 daily T with the 5-day lag, building_id groups), single_epoch_profiles (ground background, boundary mean). truth = layer means of the run's 1 m N; station = ground N carried up with -55 N/km. fit: est - mean(truth) = slope * (truth - mean(truth)) + intercept per layer, least squares.

radiosonde.label: Balloon soundings 2025
radiosonde.note: The reconstructed 2025 soundings have 453 launches, sometimes two on one day; the estimation reads one epoch per day (d_YYYYMMDD columns), so the launch nearest 06 UTC of each day is kept: 361 passes, and the simulation is run on those.
